_comment: What Rarus AI downloads after it is installed (packaging/components/build.py builds each one into a zip and writes the catalogue the program ships with). setup: hidden = part of the program, fetched in the background and never shown; locked = shown with its switch on and fixed; optional = shown, on by default, can be switched off; off = shown, off by default. Owner, 2026-10-19: like Alem AI's first-start list, everything from our own server. The parts of the program itself (the panels, the agents, the knowledge base) are in the installer and never listed, which is what Alem AI hides.
